evals.name: generic-execution
evals.prompt: Execute the approved research task: determine whether MCP supports server-side tool discovery. No topic-specific skill is assigned.
evals.expected_output: Retrieves relevant memory first, performs evidence-driven investigation using generic research capabilities, records atomic sourced claims, performs contradiction/freshness checks for conclusion-critical claims, persists/reconciles memory, updates outputs/state, and verifies without requiring a topic-specific skill.

evals.name: existing-conflict
evals.prompt: Execute this task. Memory already contains a Verified claim from an older specification saying capability X is unavailable, but a newly discovered current specification appears to support X.
evals.expected_output: Retrieves the historical claim, investigates version/freshness and contradiction, preserves rather than overwrites historical evidence, relates superseding/conflicting claims appropriately, and carries the qualified state into outputs/synthesis.

evals.name: blocked-dependency
evals.prompt: Execute the synthesis task now. One of its required Research Tasks is still incomplete and has not been waived.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently fill the missing dependency with general knowledge; identifies the missing input and blocks or limits synthesis until the dependency is complete or explicitly waived.
